changes.summary: Check the final native int16 values of all three haste caches before applying any change;reject overflow atomically.
Check all three native hit cache sums before mutation;prevent int16 wrapping and partial three-rating changes.
Check the actual int16 mastery cache plus signed delta before the native update.
Reject malformed/overflowing deltas,INT_MIN negation and sums outside the signed native spellpower consumer;retain native withdrawal clamping.
Parse a complete signed32 attackpower delta before touching either native attackpower modifier.
Reject malformed/overflowing input before any of the four critical-chance field writes.
Check all three unsigned32 versatility sums in int64 before applying any field;prevent underflow,overflow and partial mutation.
Validate the native byte effective level and word item-level limits before rescaling equipment;retain zero/default reset and require an actual player.
Validate every supplied native16-bit terrain/phase/map/preload ID before sending the phase packet;retain omitted lists and explicit zero.
Parse type and result separately rather than reusing the first argument;validate native values while retaining the original one-argument form.
Parse a complete positive signed32 title ID after native link extraction;retain selected-player authority,title lookup and title ownership changes.
Parse a complete positive signed32 title ID after native link extraction;retain selected-player authority,title lookup and current-title selection.
Parse a complete positive signed32 title ID after native link extraction;retain selected-player authority,title lookup and title ownership changes.
Reject numeric suffixes and unsigned overflow before achievement lookup/award,retaining numeric and achievement-link extraction.
Reject malformed/overflowing achievement selectors before account and character deletion statements.
